bibl.title: The Monastery of Apa Apollo as Landowner and Employer.
bibl.seg: Gesa Schenke, The Monastery of Apa Apollo as Landowner and Employer.
Micaela Langellotti & Dominic Rathbone (edd.), Village Institutions in Egypt in the Roman to Early Arab Periods = Proceedings of the British Academy. 231 (Oxford, 2020) pp. 169-177.
bibl.note: From the 4th century onwards, monasteries such as that of Apa Apollo at Bawit developed into elaborate economic units operating like secular large estates, which resulted in surrounding villagers to partake in a sanctified existence too.
